release_notes: Build 125 fixes the Autopilot startup race that could leave the real home page showing only the Working badge with no ON/OFF master switch.
The master controls are now queued immediately from startup and retry until the Autopilot header exists, instead of registering a second Loaded handler after the window has already loaded.
The automatic schedule refill startup check is queued directly as well, so Autopilot ON reliably evaluates the future scheduled-quiz target without a Fill Schedule click.
When no Autopilot preference has ever been saved, Factburst now defaults to ON with a target of 14 scheduled quizzes; an explicitly saved OFF state is still respected.
The existing five-minute refill supervisor, safe batch scheduling, account guard and failed-start no-cooldown behavior remain unchanged.
